clips.title: The story
paras: At Bael Modan, Wood Pulp helps the dwarves prepare their blasting charges. The dwarven personnel stationed in the southern Barrens carry it as an absorbent base for stabilizing liquid explosives.

At Bael Modan, Ironforge dwarves use earth-moving equipment and chemical explosives to tear into ancestral tauren hunting grounds. Liquid nitroglycerin is unstable on its own, so dwarven engineers soak it into porous wood pulp with sodium nitrate to make stable charges for excavation and combat. Riflemen, soldiers, and officers carry bundles for sapping and field munitions.
